name: qr-share
title: QR Share
description: QR code generator that reads the exact URL back under the code, re-decodes the matrix it drew to prove nothing was truncated, and warns about localhost, staging, http, invisible characters and dense codes, with one-tap fixes. Dependency-free encoder (byte mode, ECC M).

meta.stops: QR code opens the wrong page
meta.summary: Reads the exact URL back under a QR code and re-decodes what it drew, so a shared code doesn't open the wrong page.
catches: localhost or staging URLs, with a swap to publicOrigin
Invisible characters in the URL, marked with their code point
Links long enough to make a dense, hard-to-scan code
Encoder output that doesn't decode back to the URL
limits: Byte mode and error correction M only; no logos or other ECC levels
Self-check proves the matrix, not that printers or screens reproduce it well
a11y: QR SVG is role=img with an aria-label naming the URL
Issues are a polite live region; a decode mismatch uses role=alert
Draw animation is skipped under reduced motion
